basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Research Associate (Applied Mechanics) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Applied Mechanics at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi needs one Research Associate for a project funded by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation, Science and Engineering Research Board. The post pays a consolidated Rs. 58,000/- per month plus HRA @27%. It needs a Ph.D. or a 1st class M.Tech. in a listed discipline, with at least 3 years of research experience in Computational Fluid Mechanics. Only Indian nationals may apply. Candidates must email Form No. IRD/REC-4 to [email protected] by 16 November 2026, 5.00 p.m. (Advertisement No. IITD/IRD/311/2026).

how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD website of IIT Delhi (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec).
Fill in the form completely. Give your educational qualifications with the percentage of marks or division, your work experience and the Advertisement Number.
Email the filled form to Prof. Amitabh Bhattacharya at [email protected].
Write the advertisement number (IITD/IRD/311/2026) in the subject line of the email.
Send the email by 16 November 2026, 5.00 p.m.
For questions about eligibility for this post, candidates may contact Prof. Amitabh Bhattacharya at [email protected].

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Research Associate at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (Industrial Research & Development Unit)
Enhancement of Energy Harvesting via Flow Induced Flat Plate Autorotation using Externally Applied Torque Potentials. (RM00159G_SN)
Anusandhan National Research Foundation, Science and Engineering Research Board
Contractual, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project (up to 27.05.2030), whichever is earlier

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals may apply. The notice lists the following requirements for the Research Associate post: Ph.D. or 1st class M.Tech. in Applied Mechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Civil Engineering or related fields. At least 3 years of experience in research related to Computational Fluid Mechanics. Demonstrable expertise in performing fluid-structure interaction simulations in OpenFOAM. A strong background in advanced fluid mechanics. Proficiency with C++ coding and High Performance Computing. The notice says a 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates. It does not mention an age limit. See the official notification for the full eligibility for this post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate receives a consolidated fellowship of Rs. 58,000/- per month. HRA at 27% is paid in addition to this amount. If a retired or superannuated government employee is selected, his or her salary will be fixed according to the prevailing IRD norms. The appointment is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay. It is renewable yearly or runs up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. The project runs up to 27.05.2030.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Delhi Research Associate
content_sections.text: For questions about eligibility for this post, candidates may contact Prof. Amitabh Bhattacharya at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to set higher criteria to short-list candidates from among those who meet the advertised qualification and the requirements of the project post. The names of short-listed candidates will be displayed at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted together with the online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed about the online interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Delhi Research Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one Research Associate post in the Dept. of Applied Mechanics under Advertisement No. IITD/IRD/311/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by email by 16 November 2026, 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: The post requires a Ph.D. or a 1st class M.Tech. in Applied Mechanics, Mechanical, Chemical, Aerospace or Civil Engineering or a related field, with at least 3 years of research experience in Computational Fluid Mechanics. Candidates also need OpenFOAM fluid-structure interaction expertise and proficiency in C++ and High Performance Computing.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIT Delhi Research Associate?
faq.answer: The post pays a consolidated Rs. 58,000/- per month plus HRA @27%.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 58,000 pay?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA at 27% is paid in addition to the Rs. 58,000/- per month fellowship.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec and fill it in. Then email it to [email protected] with the advertisement number in the subject line.

faq.question: Q7. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Write the advertisement number, IITD/IRD/311/2026, in the subject line.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: IIT Delhi will short-list candidates, possibly using higher criteria. The short-listed names and the online interview details will be posted at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted, and only short-listed candidates will be called for the online interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is contractual. It is renewable yearly or runs up to the duration of the project (up to 27.05.2030), whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes. A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates.
